After {count} consecutive reachability failures the link is disabled and moved to "Unreachable sites"; it returns automatically once the site recovers. If it stays unreachable for more than {days} days, a cleanup job removes it from the list.

friends_policy_removal_body: Sites that break these rules are removed. The email you provide is used only to contact you about this application and is never published; for rejected or banned sites it is cleared after {days} days.
friends_policy_removal_body_public: Sites that break these rules are removed; serious or repeated violations are listed publicly under "Non-compliant sites". The email you provide is used only to contact you about this application and is never published; for rejected or banned sites it is cleared after {days} days.
friends_policy_review_body: Applications are reviewed by hand. Applications that clearly fail the hard gates (free hosting domains, restricted TLDs, banned domains) are rejected and recorded automatically; the rest are judged by a person. Approved sites appear on this page directly; no separate email is sent.
friends_policy_site_body: Your site must be publicly reachable over HTTPS and mainly used for personal writing, work, or long-term records. Content should be friendly and genuine; content farms, pure link directories, ad farms, and sites that clearly clash with this site's character are not accepted.
